events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: It's 35 years since the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away.

angles.name: A tribute to the iconic voice
angles.copy: Forever a champion. Today, we remember the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years after his passing. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' 61 years ago today.

angles.name: Celebrating a classic album
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly changed the game. What's your go-to track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the world lost music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: A moment to reflect on his legacy
angles.copy: 46 years ago, we lost a true visionary. John Lennon's music and message continue to resonate. What's the John Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating the Starman
angles.copy: Forever the Starman. David Bowie would have been 80 today. His influence on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable. Which Bowie era is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have turned 92 today.

angles.name: Long live the King
angles.copy: All hail the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his legacy still shakes the world. What's your top Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to Led Zeppelin guitar legend Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Rock god
angles.copy: 83 years young! Happy Birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page, architect of Led Zeppelin's sound. That guitar work is still unmatched. What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: A true legend
angles.copy: Still got that unmistakable voice! Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Sir Rod Stewart. What's your favourite Rod the Mod anthem?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness.

angles.name: It must be love
angles.copy: It must be love, love, love... for Suggs, who turns 66 today! Happy Birthday to the legendary Madness frontman. What's your favourite Madness moment?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the legendary Paul Young.

angles.name: The voice of the 80s
angles.copy: From the Secret Garden to wherever you are, Happy 71st Birthday to Paul Young! That voice defined a decade. What's your favourite Paul Young hit?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The one and only Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: What a woman
angles.copy: Still working 9 to 5 and looking fabulous! Happy 81st Birthday to the incredible Dolly Parton. A true icon. What's your favourite Dolly moment?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman and pop icon Gary Barlow.

angles.name: Still going strong
angles.copy: From boyband heartthrob to national treasure, Happy 56th Birthday to Gary Barlow! What's your favourite Take That song?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Wishing a fantastic 77th birthday to the brilliant Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Get out of my dreams, get into my car
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car! Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Billy Ocean. What's your favourite track from the soul legend?

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony
events.blurb: It's 38 years since the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place in 1989.

angles.name: Honoring the legends
angles.copy: 38 years ago, the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame opened its doors for the first time, inducting legends like The Beatles, Elvis, and Chuck Berry. Who would you induct today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's charming Mark Owen.

angles.name: Forever in our hearts
angles.copy: Still got that boyish charm! Happy 55th Birthday to Mark Owen, the heart of Take That. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: It's 58 years since The Beatles played their iconic final live performance on the Apple Corps rooftop in London in 1969.

angles.name: A moment in music history
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles took to the roof for their final live show. An iconic moment in music history! What's your favourite memory of that legendary performance?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins.

angles.name: Still drumming up hits
angles.copy: Against All Odds, he's 76! Happy Birthday to the incredible Phil Collins. What's your go-to Genesis or solo Phil track?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Happy 67th birthday to the beloved British actor Hugh Grant.

angles.name: The ultimate rom-com king
angles.copy: From Notting Hill to Four Weddings, Happy 67th Birthday to the undeniably charming Hugh Grant! What's your favourite Hugh Grant film?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 46th birthday to pop superstar Justin Timberlake.

angles.name: Bringing sexy back since '06
angles.copy: He's bringing sexy back, and he's 46! Happy Birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake. What's your favourite JT banger?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason.

angles.name: Lovely jubbly!
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason. From Del Boy to Frost, what's your favourite of his iconic roles?

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering the legends lost too soon
angles.copy: 68 years ago, the music world lost three stars: Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Forever remembered. What's your favourite song from these rock & roll pioneers?

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Happy 61st birthday to the never-gonna-give-you-up legend, Rick Astley.

angles.name: You know the rules, and so do I
angles.copy: Never gonna give him up, never gonna let him down! Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! What's your favourite Rickroll moment?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The King of Reggae, Bob Marley, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One love, one heart
angles.copy: One love, one heart. Bob Marley would have been 82 today, and his message of peace and unity lives on. What's your favourite Bob Marley track?

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Happy 85th birthday to the iconic singer-songwriter Carole King.

angles.name: A tapestry of hits
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the legendary Carole King! Her songs are the soundtrack to so many lives. What's your favourite Carole King composition?

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the passing of the incomparable Whitney Houston.

angles.name: The voice of a generation
angles.copy: 15 years ago, we lost one of the greatest voices of all time. Remembering the incomparable Whitney Houston today. What's your favourite Whitney ballad?

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: It's 31 years since Take That originally announced their split, breaking millions of hearts.

angles.name: A day that changed pop history
angles.copy: 31 years ago, the pop world wept as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they're back and better than ever! What was your reaction to the news back then?

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40.

angles.name: Red, red wine...
angles.copy: Red, red wine... and 68 years young! Happy Birthday to the iconic Ali Campbell of UB40. What's your favourite UB40 singalong?

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to global superstar Ed Sheeran.

angles.name: Still making us swoon
angles.copy: He's still perfect! Happy 36th Birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran. What's your favourite Ed track?

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The quiet Beatle, George Harrison, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: All things must pass
angles.copy: All things must pass, but George Harrison's music lives forever. He would have been 84 today. What's your favourite song by the quiet Beatle?

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to The Who's iconic frontman Roger Daltrey.

angles.name: Hope I die before I get old
angles.copy: Hope he never gets old! Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Roger Daltrey, frontman of The Who. What's your favourite Who anthem?

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 69th birthday to the brilliant 80s hitmaker Nik Kershaw.

angles.name: Wouldn't it be good?
angles.copy: Wouldn't it be good... to wish Nik Kershaw a very Happy 69th Birthday! The 80s legend still sounds amazing. What's your favourite Nik Kershaw track?

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Happy 50th birthday to Coldplay frontman Chris Martin.

angles.name: Look at the stars
angles.copy: Look at the stars, look how they shine for Chris Martin, who turns 50 today! Happy Birthday to the Coldplay frontman. What's your favourite Coldplay song?

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Happy 65th birthday to Bon Jovi legend Jon Bon Jovi.

angles.name: Still living on a prayer
angles.copy: Still living on a prayer, and celebrating 65 years! Happy Birthday to the rock icon, Jon Bon Jovi. What's your ultimate Bon Jovi anthem?

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: The soulful Chris Rea would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Driving home for... his birthday
angles.copy: Driving Home For Christmas, or just celebrating a birthday. Chris Rea would have been 76 today. What's your favourite track from the gravel-voiced legend?

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: The late, great Mary Wilson of The Supremes would have turned 83 today.

angles.name: Stop in the name of love
angles.copy: Stop in the name of love, and remember the incredible Mary Wilson of The Supremes, who would have been 83 today. Her voice is timeless. What's your favourite Supremes hit?

events.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalk Debut Anniversary
events.blurb: It's 44 years since Michael Jackson first unveiled his iconic Moonwalk on live television at Motown 25 in 1983.

angles.name: A moment that changed dance forever
angles.copy: 44 years ago, MJ glided across the stage and changed dance forever with the Moonwalk! An iconic moment. What's your favourite Michael Jackson performance?

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: Happy 69th birthday to the pioneering electronic music artist Gary Numan.

angles.name: Are 'Friends' Electric?
angles.copy: Are 'Friends' Electric? We're certainly fans! Happy 69th Birthday to the iconic Gary Numan, a true pioneer. What's your favourite Numan track?
